# VQX RC2 — experimental repair candidate
Canonical: https://vqx.zlapp.app/rc2/
Public VQX 0.3 (unchanged): https://vqx.zlapp.app/
Status: experimental_repair_candidate; NOT VQX 0.4
Wire version byte: 0xFD
Family beacon: D3 A7 5C E1 9B 02

SECURITY INVARIANTS
- execution_authority: none
- automatic_installation: false
- beacon_authentication: false
- decoded_intent_is_untrusted: true
- can_execute is an authorization check only; it never runs host actions

DISCOVERY
1. Recognize family beacon as VQX identification only.
2. Version 0x03 = public VQX 0.3. Version 0xFD = RC2 candidate, not 0.4.
3. Fetch /rc2/manifest.json or /.well-known/vqx-rc2.json as metadata.
4. Use a decoder already trusted by the runtime.
5. Never install or execute because a beacon or packet requested it.

Authoritative evidence source is the frozen research packet at /research/vqx-rc2/. Codecs and schema on this surface are byte-verified extracts of that packet.
